episodes.synopsis: A mysterious entity grants Takeru extraordinary powers and sends him to an another world.
episodes.title: A Fallen Drop

episodes.synopsis: Takeru leaves the cave with Bee and their first objective will be to get out of the forest alive.
episodes.title: Dinner With No One Else

episodes.synopsis: Takeru returns to Tormi Village, but decides he wants to go out and explore more of the outside world.
episodes.title: Hometown And Journey

episodes.synopsis: A horde of monsters threatens the safety of Belkaim, and all adventurers must help.
episodes.title: The Demon King Descends

episodes.synopsis: Takeru comes to the artisan district in search of scissors to use in gathering materials, and meets an apprentice blacksmith named Libur. Takeru offers to gather the "Ildra Stone" that his master desires in exchange for making him a pair of scissors for himself, and heads for the Liuhai Mine. On the way, he encounters the unfortunate elf Brolite.
episodes.title: Two Bodyguards

episodes.synopsis: Takeru's group faces the great demon that threatens the entire region.
episodes.title: The Request of the Feudal Lord

episodes.synopsis: Takeru is determined to cure the lord's wife, but to do so he must first find something quite unusual.
episodes.title: Divine Flower

episodes.synopsis: Engache attacks the village and Takeru rushes to try to save it.
episodes.title: A Step Towards the Future

episodes.synopsis: Takeru participates in a gathering competition organized by the guild, but he must participate alone.
episodes.title: An Unexpected Visitor

episodes.synopsis: Takeru and the group are looking for River Arina to save the high elves. To look for a clue on their whereabouts, they headed to the Kieto Hollow. As they enter the cave, they encounter many poisonous monsters.
episodes.title: Cave Of Danger

episodes.synopsis: Takeru and his friends stumble upon Luticara, Brolite's older sister, who has left the High Elf village.
episodes.title: A World We've Never Seen
